authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1770 uttarati explicitly gives descend/alight as well as Bhojpuri utᵃral and Hindi utarnā. Dang uṭər come down is assigned to this descending family, with the survey retroflex notation retained as a phonetic qualification rather than corrected. The shorter Dang uṭ is not included because loss of final r or a different stem needs independent support. Exact response: uṭər.
